description: Send a client a one-tap LinkedIn reconnect link over their preferred channels (BAMF delivers to EVERY resolved channel, not just the first). With no channels given, uses the user's saved preference, defaulting to Slack (posted in the client channel so the team sees it) + SMS + email. The team gets a '✅ reconnected by <name> at <time>' confirmation in Slack once both reconnect steps verify. Agency staff keys only. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only (client, channels) and sends nothing; call again with confirm=true only after the user approves. The link itself is never returned.

channels.description: Optional delivery channels, each attempted. Omit to use the user's saved preference (default Slack + SMS + email). WhatsApp is gated behind the RECONNECT_WHATSAPP_ENABLED flag and provider credentials.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name (must be a client of an agency you own, admin, or manage).

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true sends.

name: bamf.send_linkedin_reauth_link
